label: Deviations and disclosures; this file is deliberately not hashed by FREEZE.json

entries.what: A smoke run of develop.py (KR_SMOKE: one compound in eight, one control seed) wrote tmp/knowledge_reality_20261013/smoke_development.json at 18:13:08 local time; the registered run started 32 s later. The smoke run checked that the pipeline completes and set the run-time estimate. Its output holds response-derived numbers on the subsample. DEV_PLAN.md (written 18:06) is unchanged: its sha256 5db5f4ea... is recorded in both outputs. The only code change between the two runs was a warnings filter for all-NaN slices.

While the registered development run was in progress, develop.control_edges was generalised for confirm.py's sealed stratum: the three loops 'for f in range(5)' became 'for f in strata' with strata = np.unique(fold). On the development tables, the edited and the original function return identical edge arrays for the degree, setperm and relabel controls at seeds 0 and 7, so the running process (which had loaded the original text) and the frozen file produce the same nulls. FREEZE.json hashes the edited file; verify.py --replay reruns it.

CENSUS.json first recorded the Repurposing Hub licence as CC BY 4.0. The Hub file header restricts use to non-commercial purposes. census.py was corrected and CENSUS.json regenerated; the edge table and tables.npz are unchanged (sha256 checked).

Structure parsing differs between tiers. The development census (census.py, build.py) splits PRISM 19Q4 SMILES on commas and leaves 4 of 4,532 compounds unparsable; they are excluded. Hub 2020 sample structures are CXSMILES whose stereo block after ' |' contains commas, so sealed_census.py strips that block first; without the strip, 149 sealed compounds would have been refused.

Metadata download: the 24Q2 README, compound list, treatment metadata and cell-line metadata (about 2.4 MB) were downloaded from Figshare article 25917643 through the public API to define eligibility. Their MD5s match Figshare's. No 24Q2 response value was downloaded. The DepMap portal showed a bot-verification page; it was not bypassed.

sealed_census.py was extended after SEALED_CENSUS.json was first written. It now writes sealed_overlap.csv (the 49 REP.1M compounds refused as present in 19Q4, with their 19Q4 cores) and an 'overlap_with_19q4' count, for the replication ceiling. Eligibility is unchanged: sealed_compounds.csv is byte-identical (md5 6689838d...).

Time-matched knowledge control on 19Q4 is impossible (TIME_STAMPS_UNAVAILABLE, registered in DEV_PLAN.md): no edge in either source has a date, and the Hub file (2020-03-24) postdates the PRISM 19Q4 release. The sealed design substitutes a snapshot contrast: Hub 2020, which predates the 24Q2 outcomes, against MAP-KG 2026, which postdates them.

Prior art (PRESAGE, TxPert, PIE, MAP) was assessed from abstracts and records gathered by earlier blocks, not full texts. Their controls and evaluation details may be under-reported in README.md section 1.

PROTOCOL.md was drafted while the development run was in progress and completed after DEVELOPMENT.json existed. The parts written after it are section 0 (gate status), section 9 (power, from power.py) and confirm.MIN_ACTIVE (read from POWER.json). Hypotheses H1 and H2, the arms, the controls and the endpoint follow DEV_PLAN.md, which was registered before any response value was read. No sealed 24Q2 response value exists locally.
